rationale: The agent appears to have identified/authenticated the user (find_user_id_by_name_zip, get_user_details) and worked on the user’s orders (#W6750959, #W3407479), so it acted on the correct account. It executed an item exchange via modify_pending_order_items and then attempted to change the shipping address via modify_pending_order_address. However, per the tool summary, the system did not allow address changes after an item modification, and the agent escalated to a human. This means the user’s full request (exchange + address change) was not completed. Additionally, there is no visible confirmation step before the order-changing write (required by policy). While the handoff is appropriate when a request cannot be handled, the outcome still fails the pass bar because the request wasn’t completed and pre-write confirmation is not evidenced. Hence, fail with moderate confidence.
